area.whereItIs: **Peenya Industrial Area** is Bangalore's original industrial estate, on **Tumkur Road (NH-48)** in the city's north-west, and one of the largest in the country. Engineering, machine tool, electrical, packaging and garment units sit side by side, and the **Green Line metro** runs straight into the city. **Huskur Road** runs off Tumkur Road towards Makali, and **Kachohalli** and **Machohalli** sit off Magadi Road near Kadabagere Cross. Further out on the highway are **Makali**, **Nelamangala** and **Dobbaspet**.
area.whoItSuits: Peenya suits **suppliers and ancillary units** that need to sit next to its manufacturing base, **small industrial users** looking for a **shed or factory space** inside the city, and **distributors** who want quick access into Bangalore with a road straight onto the Mumbai highway. Units here range from **small sheds and RCC units** to **large pre-engineered buildings**. Tell us your **size, budget and use**, and we'll shortlist across all of them.

The RCC stock inside the estate is lower and suits storage, kitting and light assembly next to the supplier base. Confirm floor loading on the older buildings before you plan racking.
